summary: Tools differ mainly in source-of-truth placement. The pattern can export to any of them as long as the repository identifier and immutable content version survive the integration.

items.text: Prompty: closest file-first substrate; add stable cross-run identity and version aggregates to its local traces.
LangSmith: reuse prompt commits, tags and rich runs; keep a repository sync or mapping when code-coupled review is the governing workflow.
PromptLayer: its explicit request-to-template-version association is directly transferable to the minimal call ledger.
Langfuse: versions, labels and prompt-to-trace links provide a ready observability projection, including a self-hosted option.

Humanloop (discontinued): its serialized prompt files and version-linked logs are a historical example of the hybrid boundary; the platform was sunset on 8 September 2025 and is not a current implementation choice.
